title: New definitions of a solution of a one-dimensional elliptic equation with a singular first order divergence term
summary: In this paper, which is a continuation of our recent paper [1], we give two new definitions of a weak solution of the one-dimensional, elliptic, nonlinear singular problem which is formally written as $$ \begin{cases} \displaystyle -\frac{d}{dx}\left(a(x) \frac{d u}{dx}\right) = - \frac{d φ(u) }{dx}- \frac{d g(x) }{dx}& \text{in}\;(0,L),\\ \newline u(0)=u(L)=0\,, & \end{cases} $$ where $φ:\mathbb{R}\mapsto\mathbb{R}\cup\{+\infty\}$ is a singular function whose model is given by $\displaystyleφ(s)=φ_γ(s)=\frac{1}{|s|^γ}$ with $γ>0$.
